paragraphs: The X-Type 2.5 V6 uses the AJ25 — a 2.5-litre V6 petrol engine derived from the Ford Duratec family, fitted throughout the X400 generation's production from 2001 to 2009. The V6 engines in the X-Type all share the same fundamental architecture, with the key difference being capacity: 2.0, 2.5, and 3.0-litre variants (AJ20, AJ25, AJ30 respectively). The 2.5 V6 sits in the middle of the petrol range, offering a balance of performance and refinement that made it a popular choice for UK buyers. The X-Type is no longer in production, but we continue to rebuild and replace engines for every one still on the road.
about.boldParagraph: We continue to rebuild and replace AJ25 engines for every X-Type 2.5 V6 on the road.

cards.body: A 2.5-litre V6 petrol engine fitted to the X-Type from 2001 to 2009 (X400). Known for coil-on-plug ignition coil degradation, often accelerated by oil contamination from leaking valve cover gaskets — see the callout above. We replace ignition coils and valve cover gaskets as standard on every AJ25 rebuild, along with timing chain components and bearings where worn.

compatibility.intro: Because the X-Type's V6 engines (AJ20, AJ25, AJ30) share the same Duratec-derived architecture but differ in capacity, confirming your exact engine code matters for correct component sourcing — particularly for parts like ignition coils, valve cover gaskets, and timing chain components. Before we quote or supply anything, we confirm:

points.text: Your exact engine code (AJ25) via registration or VIN
